native_requests.scope: Counts TERMINAL shim replacement/failure events, not repeated jit-info or simultaneousprogram count. Frozen guestentry explicitly unsets REQUIRE_BOUND_PROOF; CAPI FdLoadOptions defaults trusted_service_fd=-1 and routes load_from_fd unbound. No checkedB/stock-verifier admission is claimed. Original/nativeIDs require actual samePID/TID/fd info rows; unknown associations stayNone.

lines.text: # LOGS/progress.log names each run's start, end and artifact_run_dir; touch LOGS/STOP to stop
// number of calls to interpreter unwinding in get_next_interpreter()
// number of failures due to PC == 0 in unwind_next_frame()
// number of times MAX_STACK_LEN has been exceeded
// number of failures to read the TSD address
// number of failures to read the TSD base in get_tls_base()

limits: Stats-on entry counters do not by themselves prove deeperwork/eventdelivery; inspect actualmaps/code/workload outputs.
Map observations retain allmetadata but query only selectedarray/progarray/RO entries; HASHcontents and largepercpuvalues remainunobserved except focusedOTelprobes.
Each snapshot captures data sequentially, can add seconds of work or cross the phase; exact spans/commanderrors and sourceSHA retained.
JIT subprograms have separate actual function VMAs; do not disassemble concatenated raw code as one contiguous addressrange.
Current host schedulingconfound is proven in previoussameimage diagnostics; short numbers are not speedupacceptance.
Direct-native admission is not checkedB/stock-verifier coverage; featureprobe skips are not failed native requests.
